structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. A money-market fund (קרן כספית) seems to pay more than my deposit (3.25% against 1.8% for a year) and I can take the money out any trading day. But it says nothing is guaranteed, the value can go down, there's no state guarantee or insurance, and I couldn't find how much it actually costs. So I'll ask you, and the clerk at the bank, before I move anything.
